title: 第13章 内景成真法第14章 小周天服气法
content_zh:
;;
信心倍增的张唯，迫不及待地尝试这新得的力量。
就见他屏息凝神，立于客厅中央，手印迅捷结出，口中咒语急快且清晰吐出。
“天罡耀灵，北斗垂光。魒星指路，魑魅伏藏。焚符破秽，炁摄不祥。丹朱口神，卫我真常！”
要是有旁人在场的话，只能听到张唯嘴里咕哝一下，具体喊啥属实说不清，只当是嚎唠一嗓子吓人一跳。
咒毕，张唯略显紧张地环顾四周。
然而，室内一片寂静，灯光依旧，空气如常。
连半点清风都没有掀起半点。
什么事情都没有发生。
期待与现实的反差让张唯微微一怔，苦思许久，又看了眼视界上属性面板中根据他心念适时跳出来的信息提示，随即了然。
‘你在现世中使用了天罡驱邪咒，似乎什么事情都没发生’
张唯捏着下巴想了很久，想起一叶之修强调的心诚则灵以及自己之前的猜测，现实中灵气稀薄或规则不同，法术难以显化。
那么这门咒在内景中可以运用吗？
一想至此，张唯颇有些急不可耐的想要进入内景验证。
当晚，吃过晚饭后，他盘膝坐忘，意识沉入内景世界。
提着那盏昏黄的运火灯，他再次感受到安全屋内那熟悉的阴冷死寂。
熟稔的提着运火灯绕了一圈，确认屋内无异常后，这才将运火灯挂在腰间。
他深吸一口略带污浊的空气，这些天以来，他都习惯内景世界里面的浑浊空气了。
吸着吸着，有时候还觉得挺自在享受。
张唯目光看向客厅那面斑驳的墙壁。

手印瞬间结成，咒语如惊雷般在内景的死寂中炸响。
“天罡耀灵，北斗垂光！
魒星指路，魑魅伏藏！
焚符破秽，炁摄不祥！
丹朱口神，卫我真常！”
这一次，异象陡生。
随着咒语最后一个音节落下，他结印的双手间猛地荡开一抹清冷的光晕，如同水波般迅速向四周扩散开去。
清光所过之处，屋内弥漫的阴寒腐朽之气仿佛被无形的力量涤荡驱散，空气都为之一清。
那感觉，如同污浊的水面被投入了明矾。
转眼就清晰明了许多。
紧接着，张唯念头一动，对着那面布满深褐色污渍的斑驳墙壁凌空一指。
“咻！”
荡出去的光晕瞬间收束，化为一点凝练的清光自指尖迸发而出，疾如闪电，瞬间击中墙壁。
嗤！
一声轻微的灼烧声响起。
墙壁上那深褐色的污渍如同遇到克星，迅速消融褪色，露出底下更灰败的墙体。
而在污渍中心，赫然留下了一个拇指粗细，边缘焦黑的小洞。
“成了！”
张唯心中狂喜。

Zhang Wei's confidence doubled and he couldn't wait to try this new power.
He was seen holding his breath and concentrating, standing in the center of the living room, quickly forming his hand seals, and spitting out the mantras quickly and clearly.
"Tiangang shines brightly, Beidou shines down. The zodiac stars point the way, and evil spirits hide. Burning talismans destroys filth, and Qi captures ominousness. Danzhu Moushen, guard me forever!"
If there were other people present, Zhang Wei could only be heard grunting. I couldn't tell exactly what he was shouting, but I just thought it was a startling howl.
After finishing the curse, Zhang Wei looked around nervously.
However, there was silence in the room, the lights were still on, and the air was as usual.
Not even the slightest breeze stirred up the air.
Nothing happened.
The contrast between expectation and reality made Zhang Wei slightly startled. He thought hard for a long time, then looked at the information prompts that popped up in the attribute panel on the horizon according to his thoughts, and then he understood.
‘You have used the Tiangang Exorcism Curse in this world, but nothing seems to have happened’
Zhang Wei held her chin and thought for a long time, remembering Yiye Zhixiu's emphasis on sincerity and spirituality and his previous guess. In reality, the spiritual energy is thin or the rules are different, making it difficult for spells to manifest.
So can this spell be used in interior scenes?
After thinking about this, Zhang Wei was quite impatient and wanted to enter the interior for verification.
That night, after dinner, he sat cross-legged and forgot, and his consciousness sank into the interior world.
Holding the dim yellow fire lantern, he once again felt the familiar cold and dead silence in the safe house.
Familiarly, he walked around with the fire lantern in a circle, and after confirming that there was nothing unusual in the house, he hung the fire lantern around his waist.
He took a deep breath of the slightly filthy air. Over the past few days, he had become accustomed to the turbid air in the interior world.
As I sucked on it, sometimes I felt quite comfortable and enjoying it.
Zhang Wei looked at the mottled wall in the living room.
The hand seals were formed instantly, and the spell exploded like thunder in the dead silence of the interior scene.
"Tiangang shines brightly, Beidou shines down!
The star guides the way, and the evil spirit hides!
Burning the talisman will destroy the filth, and the Qi will be ominous!
Danzhu's mouth is magical, and it protects me so often! "
This time, a vision suddenly occurred.
As the last syllable of the spell fell, a cool halo of light suddenly spread out between his sealed hands, quickly spreading around like water waves.
Wherever the clear light passed, the cold and decaying air that filled the room seemed to be washed away and dispersed by invisible forces, and the air became clear.
It felt like alum had been thrown into the filthy water.
It became much clearer in the blink of an eye.
Then, Zhang Wei had an idea and pointed his finger in the air at the mottled wall covered with dark brown stains.
"Phew!"
The halo that swayed out instantly stopped and turned into a bit of condensed clear light that burst out from the fingertips, as fast as lightning, and hit the wall instantly.
laugh!
There was a slight burning sound.
The dark brown stains on the wall seemed to have encountered a nemesis, quickly melting and fading, revealing the even grayer wall underneath.
In the center of the stain, a small hole as thick as a thumb with a burnt black edge was left.
"It's done!"
Zhang Wei was ecstatic.
